newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch unions and Nerefco agree on lay-off plans.
newsitem.headline: Dutch unions and Nerefco agree on lay-off plans.

text.p: Dutch unions and the management of Nerefco reached agreement early on Saturday over the lay-off of workers at the company's Pernis refinery, stalling possible industrial action, the company said on Saturday.
"The unions will present the accord favourably to their members on Thursday October 17," the company said.

The Pernis refinery in Rotterdam, operated by BP /Texaco joint venture Nerefco, is due to close in 1999. The company is to expand production at its other refinery, Europoort, at a cost of 350 million guilders ($204.1 million), but will still lay off 350 of its 875 employees.
Last week, workers rejected the original social plan proposed by the management, and on Monday some workers staged a brief wild-cat strike of two to three hours.
Management met representatives of the FNV Industriebond and the CNV unions and reached the accord some 12 hours after talks began.
